name: Task
notes: Work to do; due or window optional; not a clock event by default

name: Calendar event
notes: Fixed start and end; tasks schedule around these

name: Routine
notes: Repeating expected work; preferred window not a hard start

name: Habit
notes: Streak-optional practice; separate from a one-off task

name: Project
notes: Container for tasks; not itself a timeline block

name: Inbox item
notes: Unclassified capture; not scheduled until processed

name: Time block
notes: Planned occupancy on the day timeline (task or event snapshot)

name: Meal window
notes: Flexible meal window unless the meal is a fixed event

name: Protected time
notes: Sleep family commute rest; AI must not fill
